context_requirements: Neuronal lineage or APP-expressing cells for meaningful beta-amyloid neurotoxicity
Expression of APP and the gamma-secretase complex
None of the nine tested lines are neuronal; they are melanoma, lung, kidney, liver, colon, breast, and prostate lines
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine non-neuronal lines
Changes in APP or APP-processing genes (e.g., BACE2, ADAM10, APOE) beyond vehicle noise
Induction of generic stress, apoptosis, or UPR programs at 10 micromolar in these lines
